北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感适中，注意保持好心情哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast with a pleasant feels-like temperature. Keep a good mood!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波有霾，体感 33℃。出门请戴口罩，注意防护！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has haze, feels like 33℃. Please wear a mask when going out and take precautions!
宁波.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 29℃ 略闷，记得轻装出行呀！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 29℃ and a bit muggy. Remember to dress lightly!
上海.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴热，体感 36℃，出门记得做好防晒哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and hot, feels like 36℃. Don't forget your sunscreen when going out!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳艳阳高照，体感 34℃，小心中暑，多喝水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot, feels like 34℃. Be careful of heatstroke and drink plenty of water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雨伴强风 8级，体感 22℃，出行注意安全哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has heavy rain and strong winds (level 8), feels like 22℃. Please travel safely!
杭州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降16℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 8级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阵雨，湿度 100%，体感 21℃。带伞注意防潮！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has showers, 100% humidity, feels like 21℃. Take an umbrella and mind the dampness!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 28℃，有些闷热，注意通风哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 28℃ and a bit muggy. Ensure good ventilation!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，湿度 92%，体感 27℃ 较闷，心情也要“清爽”哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, 92% humidity, feels like 27℃ and muggy. Keep your spirits 'fresh'!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 24℃，天气舒适，心情也美丽！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 24℃. The weather is comfortable, wishing you a beautiful mood!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 30℃，小心闷热，清淡饮食哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 30℃. Watch out for mugginess, and choose a light diet!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 10℃，有点凉，记得添衣保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast, feels like 10℃. It's a bit chilly, remember to add layers to stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 20℃，温度适宜，享受好天气吧！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like 20℃. The temperature is pleasant, enjoy the good weather!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 26℃，风力 4级。舒适宜人，注意防晒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 26℃ with level 4 wind. It's pleasant, but mind the sun!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 28℃，风力 4级。多喝水，小心晒黑哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 28℃ with level 4 wind. Drink plenty of water and watch out for sunburn!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 23℃。气候宜人，可以放松心情哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast, feels like 23℃. The climate is pleasant, you can relax and enjoy!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 21℃，很舒服。祝您度过愉快的一天！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like 21℃, very comfortable. Wishing you a pleasant day!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦晴天，体感 34℃。阳光猛烈，记得戴帽子哦！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is sunny, feels like 34℃. The sun is strong, remember to wear a hat!
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 33℃，热意浓，多补水防暑哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 33℃. It's hot, stay hydrated to prevent heatstroke!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃
